body:
this is the chapter i always forget is only two months long.

late 2009 into early 2010, Taylor and John Mayer — brief, complicated, and the source of one of the most unflinching songs in her whole catalog.

'Dear John' runs almost seven minutes, and she uses every one of them to say exactly what she meant. it lives on Speak Now, the album she wrote entirely by herself, every single song — a 20-year-old answering for herself on her own record 😮‍💨

it's the next stop in Blank Spaces, our relationship timeline: every era's heartbreak, mapped in order, receipts only.

tag the friend who still isn't over Speak Now.

read it start to finish 👉 https://longlivets.com/?lens=love-story&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=timeline
